articles.title: International Day of Friendship — 30 July
articles.summary: International Day of Friendship is observed on 30 July every year to promote friendship as a bridge to peace and understanding among peoples, countries, and cultures.
articles.summary_hi: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय मित्रता दिवस हर वर्ष 30 जुलाई को मनाया जाता है, जो लोगों, देशों और संस्कृतियों के बीच शांति व समझ के सेतु के रूप में मित्रता को बढ़ावा देता है।
articles.content:
International Day of Friendship falls on 30 July every year. The United Nations General Assembly proclaimed the observance in 2011, building on an idea that traces back to a 1958 initiative by the World Friendship Crusade, a civil organisation founded in Paraguay.

The day promotes the idea that friendship between peoples, countries, cultures, and individuals can inspire peace efforts and build bridges between communities. India traditionally observes a separate Friendship Day on the first Sunday of August (2 August in 2026).

For IB ACIO: UN Day — 30 July, proclaimed 2011, India's separate observance — first Sunday of August.
articles.content_hi:
International Day of Friendship: 30 जुलाई। UN महासभा द्वारा 2011 में घोषित। भारत में पृथक Friendship Day — अगस्त के पहले रविवार को (2026 में 2 अगस्त)।

IB ACIO: 30 July, UN 2011 — याद रखें।
articles.question: International Day of Friendship, proclaimed by the UN General Assembly in 2011, is observed every year on:
articles.question_hi: 2011 में UN महासभा द्वारा घोषित अंतर्राष्ट्रीय मित्रता दिवस प्रतिवर्ष कब मनाया जाता है?
articles.explanation: The UN General Assembly designated 30 July as the International Day of Friendship in 2011.
articles.explanation_hi: UN महासभा ने 2011 में 30 जुलाई को अंतर्राष्ट्रीय मित्रता दिवस के रूप में नामित किया।
articles.moreInfo: Related: World Day against Trafficking in Persons, also observed 30 July (this edition, article 2).
articles.moreInfo_hi: संबंधित: विश्व मानव तस्करी विरोधी दिवस, भी 30 जुलाई को मनाया जाता है (इसी अंक का लेख 2)।

articles.title: World Day Against Trafficking in Persons 2026 — Theme 'Trapped Behind the Scam'
articles.title_hi: विश्व मानव तस्करी विरोधी दिवस 2026 — थीम 'Trapped Behind the Scam'
articles.summary: World Day Against Trafficking in Persons, observed on 30 July, carries the 2026 UNODC theme 'Trapped Behind the Scam', highlighting trafficking for forced criminality in online scam operations.
articles.summary_hi: 30 जुलाई को मनाया जाने वाला विश्व मानव तस्करी विरोधी दिवस 2026 में UNODC की थीम 'Trapped Behind the Scam' के तहत ऑनलाइन घोटाला संचालन में जबरन अपराध हेतु तस्करी को उजागर करता है।
articles.content:
World Day Against Trafficking in Persons is observed on 30 July, following a 2013 UN General Assembly resolution designating the date to raise awareness of trafficking victims and promote protection of their rights.

The 2026 theme, set by the UN Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC), is 'Trapped Behind the Scam', drawing attention to people trafficked into online scam compounds and forced into cyber-enabled fraud through coercion and debt. The day's symbol, the Blue Heart, represents solidarity with trafficking victims.

For IB ACIO: 30 July, UNGA resolution 2013, UNODC, 2026 theme — 'Trapped Behind the Scam', Blue Heart Campaign.
articles.content_hi:
World Day Against Trafficking in Persons: 30 जुलाई, UNGA प्रस्ताव 2013। 2026 थीम — 'Trapped Behind the Scam' (UNODC), ऑनलाइन घोटाला तस्करी पर केंद्रित। प्रतीक — Blue Heart Campaign।

IB ACIO: 30 July, UNODC, Blue Heart — याद रखें।
articles.question: The UNODC theme for World Day Against Trafficking in Persons 2026 is:
articles.question_hi: विश्व मानव तस्करी विरोधी दिवस 2026 हेतु UNODC की थीम क्या है?
articles.explanation: UNODC's 2026 theme, 'Trapped Behind the Scam', focuses on trafficking for forced criminality in online scam operations.
articles.explanation_hi: UNODC की 2026 थीम 'Trapped Behind the Scam' ऑनलाइन घोटाला संचालन में जबरन अपराध हेतु तस्करी पर केंद्रित है।

articles.title: President Droupadi Murmu Marks Four Years in Office
articles.title_hi: राष्ट्रपति द्रौपदी मुर्मु ने राष्ट्रपति पद के चार वर्ष पूरे किए
articles.summary: President Droupadi Murmu launched several initiatives at Rashtrapati Bhavan to mark the completion of four years of her presidency, with Vice-President C.P. Radhakrishnan releasing five commemorative books.
articles.summary_hi: राष्ट्रपति द्रौपदी मुर्मु ने अपने राष्ट्रपति पद के चार वर्ष पूरे होने पर राष्ट्रपति भवन में कई पहल शुरू कीं, जिसमें उपराष्ट्रपति सी.पी. राधाकृष्णन ने पांच स्मृति पुस्तकों का विमोचन किया।
articles.content:
In July 2026, President Droupadi Murmu launched several initiatives at Rashtrapati Bhavan and the President's Estates, New Delhi, to mark four years of her presidency. Murmu was sworn in as the 15th President on 25 July 2022, becoming the country's first tribal head of state.

Vice-President C.P. Radhakrishnan released five commemorative books tracing her four-year journey, published by the Publications Division, Ministry of Information and Broadcasting. Key initiatives launched include an e-Audio guide, e-Upahaar (3rd edition), Bachpan 'Bal Parisar', and RAAHI (Rashtrapati Bhavan Access And Heritage Interconnector).

For IB ACIO: Droupadi Murmu — 15th President, sworn in 25 July 2022, first tribal head of state, RAAHI initiative.
articles.content_hi:
Droupadi Murmu: 15वीं राष्ट्रपति, शपथ — 25 जुलाई 2022, प्रथम आदिवासी राष्ट्रपति। VP C.P. Radhakrishnan — 5 स्मृति पुस्तकें विमोचित। पहल: RAAHI, e-Upahaar, Bachpan Bal Parisar।

IB ACIO: Murmu, 15th President, 25 July 2022 — याद रखें।
articles.question: President Droupadi Murmu, who marked four years in office in July 2026, was sworn in as India's 15th President on:
articles.question_hi: जुलाई 2026 में राष्ट्रपति पद के चार वर्ष पूरे करने वाली द्रौपदी मुर्मु ने भारत की 15वीं राष्ट्रपति के रूप में कब शपथ ली थी?
articles.explanation: Droupadi Murmu was sworn in as India's 15th President on 25 July 2022, becoming the country's first tribal head of state.
articles.explanation_hi: द्रौपदी मुर्मु ने 25 जुलाई 2022 को भारत की 15वीं राष्ट्रपति के रूप में शपथ ली और देश की पहली आदिवासी राष्ट्राध्यक्ष बनीं।

articles.title: MHA: Over 12,000 e-Zero FIRs Registered for Cyber Financial Fraud in 2025
articles.title_hi: MHA: 2025 में साइबर वित्तीय धोखाधड़ी हेतु 12,000 से अधिक e-Zero FIR दर्ज
articles.summary: Union MoS Home Bandi Sanjay Kumar told the Lok Sabha that over 12,000 e-Zero FIRs for cyber financial fraud were registered across 18 states and UTs in 2025, with Delhi topping the list.
articles.summary_hi: केंद्रीय गृह राज्य मंत्री बंडी संजय कुमार ने लोकसभा को बताया कि 2025 में 18 राज्यों और केंद्र शासित प्रदेशों में साइबर वित्तीय धोखाधड़ी हेतु 12,000 से अधिक e-Zero FIR दर्ज हुईं, जिसमें दिल्ली सबसे आगे रहा।
articles.content:
In July 2026, Union Minister of State for Home Affairs Bandi Sanjay Kumar informed the Lok Sabha that over 12,000 Electronic Zero (e-Zero) FIRs were registered against cyber financial fraud across 18 states and Union Territories in 2025. Delhi recorded the highest number with 6,115 FIRs (since May 2025), followed by Chandigarh with 4,174 FIRs (since November 2025).

The e-Zero FIR system, launched by the Government of India in May 2025, lets cyber financial fraud victims lodge complaints via the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal (NCRP) or the 1930 helpline; complainants must visit the police station within 3 days to convert it into a regular FIR.

For IB ACIO: e-Zero FIR, launched May 2025, NCRP, 1930 helpline, Delhi tops with 6,115 FIRs.
articles.content_hi:
e-Zero FIR: लॉन्च — मई 2025। 2025 में 12,000+ FIR, 18 राज्य/UT। शीर्ष — Delhi (6,115), उसके बाद Chandigarh (4,174)। पोर्टल — NCRP, हेल्पलाइन — 1930। नियमित FIR में बदलने हेतु 3 दिन के भीतर थाना जाना अनिवार्य।

IB ACIO: e-Zero FIR, NCRP, 1930 — याद रखें।
articles.question: As per data shared in the Lok Sabha in July 2026, which state/UT registered the highest number of e-Zero FIRs for cyber financial fraud in 2025?
articles.question_hi: जुलाई 2026 में लोकसभा में साझा किए गए आंकड़ों के अनुसार, 2025 में साइबर वित्तीय धोखाधड़ी हेतु सबसे अधिक e-Zero FIR किस राज्य/UT में दर्ज हुईं?
articles.explanation: Delhi recorded the highest number of e-Zero FIRs among 18 states/UTs, with 6,115 FIRs registered since May 2025.
articles.explanation_hi: 18 राज्यों/UT में दिल्ली ने सबसे अधिक e-Zero FIR दर्ज कीं — मई 2025 से अब तक 6,115।

articles.title: ACC Appoints Satya Pal Kumar as Director, FIU-IND
articles.title_hi: ACC ने सत्य पाल कुमार को FIU-IND का निदेशक नियुक्त किया
articles.summary: The Appointments Committee of the Cabinet appointed Satya Pal Kumar, a 2005-batch IRS officer, as Director of the Financial Intelligence Unit-India (FIU-IND) for a five-year tenure.
articles.summary_hi: मंत्रिमंडल की नियुक्ति समिति ने 2005-बैच के IRS अधिकारी सत्य पाल कुमार को वित्तीय आसूचना इकाई-भारत (FIU-IND) का निदेशक पांच वर्ष के कार्यकाल हेतु नियुक्त किया।
articles.content:
In July 2026, the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC) appointed Satya Pal Kumar, a 2005-batch Indian Revenue Service (IRS) officer of the Income Tax cadre, as Director of the Financial Intelligence Unit-India (FIU-IND) under the Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance. He succeeded Pankaj Kumar Mishra (IRS, 1989 batch), who had held the post since May 2016.

Kumar, previously Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals), Mumbai, was appointed for a five-year tenure at Joint Secretary rank. FIU-IND, established in 2004 and headquartered in New Delhi, analyses and disseminates information on suspicious financial transactions to combat money laundering and terror financing.

For IB ACIO: FIU-IND established 2004, HQ New Delhi, new Director — Satya Pal Kumar, 5-year tenure.
articles.content_hi:
FIU-IND: स्थापना 2004, मुख्यालय नई दिल्ली। नए निदेशक — Satya Pal Kumar (2005-बैच IRS), 5 वर्ष कार्यकाल। पूर्ववर्ती — Pankaj Kumar Mishra (2016 से)।

IB ACIO: FIU-IND 2004, Satya Pal Kumar — याद रखें।
articles.question: Satya Pal Kumar, appointed Director of FIU-IND in July 2026, belongs to which service?
articles.question_hi: जुलाई 2026 में FIU-IND के निदेशक नियुक्त सत्य पाल कुमार किस सेवा से संबंधित हैं?
articles.explanation: Satya Pal Kumar is a 2005-batch Indian Revenue Service (IRS) officer of the Income Tax cadre.
articles.explanation_hi: सत्य पाल कुमार 2005-बैच के भारतीय राजस्व सेवा (आयकर संवर्ग) अधिकारी हैं।

articles.title: India Becomes World's 2nd Largest Supplier of Seafarers: BIMCO-ICS Report
articles.title_hi: भारत विश्व का दूसरा सबसे बड़ा नाविक आपूर्तिकर्ता बना: BIMCO-ICS रिपोर्ट
articles.summary: According to the BIMCO-ICS Seafarer Workforce Report 2026, India became the world's second-largest supplier of seafarers with 311,936 professionals, behind the Philippines.
articles.summary_hi: BIMCO-ICS Seafarer Workforce Report 2026 के अनुसार, भारत 311,936 पेशेवरों के साथ विश्व का दूसरा सबसे बड़ा नाविक आपूर्तिकर्ता बना, जो फिलीपींस के बाद है।
articles.content:
In July 2026, the BIMCO-ICS Seafarer Workforce Report 2026, released jointly by the Baltic and International Maritime Council (BIMCO) and the International Chamber of Shipping (ICS), ranked India as the world's second-largest supplier of seafarers with 311,936 professionals, or 12.16% of the global workforce — behind the Philippines and ahead of China, Russia, and Indonesia.

India's maritime workforce climbed from 5th position in 2015 (5.2% global share) to 2nd position in 2026, more than doubling its contribution over the decade. The report estimates global seafarer supply at 2.57 million against a demand of 2.55 million, pointing to a shortage of qualified officers.

For IB ACIO: BIMCO-ICS Report 2026, India — 2nd largest seafarer supplier, up from 5th (2015).
articles.content_hi:
BIMCO-ICS Seafarer Workforce Report 2026: भारत — विश्व का दूसरा सबसे बड़ा नाविक आपूर्तिकर्ता (311,936 पेशेवर, 12.16% हिस्सा), फिलीपींस के बाद। 2015 में 5वां स्थान (5.2%) से सुधार।

IB ACIO: BIMCO-ICS, India 2nd — याद रखें।
articles.question: As per the BIMCO-ICS Seafarer Workforce Report 2026, India ranks as the world's second-largest supplier of seafarers, behind:
articles.question_hi: BIMCO-ICS Seafarer Workforce Report 2026 के अनुसार, भारत विश्व का दूसरा सबसे बड़ा नाविक आपूर्तिकर्ता है, किसके बाद?
articles.explanation: India ranks second after the Philippines, ahead of China, Russia, and Indonesia, as per the BIMCO-ICS Seafarer Workforce Report 2026.
articles.explanation_hi: BIMCO-ICS Seafarer Workforce Report 2026 के अनुसार भारत फिलीपींस के बाद दूसरे स्थान पर है, जबकि चीन, रूस और इंडोनेशिया उससे पीछे हैं।

articles.title: FSID and C-DOT Set Up Telecom Centre of Excellence at IISc Bengaluru
articles.title_hi: FSID और C-DOT ने IISc बेंगलुरु में दूरसंचार उत्कृष्टता केंद्र स्थापित किया
articles.summary: The Foundation for Science Innovation and Development and C-DOT signed an agreement with IISc Bengaluru to set up a telecom Centre of Excellence focused on 5G, 6G, AI, and quantum communication.
articles.summary_hi: फाउंडेशन फॉर साइंस इनोवेशन एंड डेवलपमेंट और C-DOT ने IISc बेंगलुरु के साथ 5G, 6G, AI और क्वांटम संचार पर केंद्रित दूरसंचार उत्कृष्टता केंद्र स्थापित करने हेतु समझौता किया।
articles.content:
In July 2026, the Foundation for Science Innovation and Development (FSID) and the Centre for Development of Telematics (C-DOT), under the Department of Telecommunications, signed an agreement with the Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bengaluru, to establish a Centre of Excellence (CoE) for advanced telecom research focused on 5G, 6G, AI, cybersecurity, and quantum communication technologies.

The IISc Bengaluru centre becomes C-DOT's 5th CoE, following centres at IIT Kanpur, IIT Gandhinagar, IIT Roorkee, and IIT Hyderabad. FSID, established in 2020 and based at IISc Bengaluru, is headed by Prof. G. Rangarajan, Director of IISc.

For IB ACIO: C-DOT's 5th CoE — IISc Bengaluru, focus — 5G/6G/AI/quantum communication.
articles.content_hi:
Telecom CoE: FSID + C-DOT + IISc Bengaluru। C-DOT का 5वां CoE (पूर्व — IIT Kanpur, Gandhinagar, Roorkee, Hyderabad)। फोकस — 5G, 6G, AI, cybersecurity, quantum communication।

IB ACIO: C-DOT 5th CoE, IISc Bengaluru — याद रखें।
articles.question: The new telecom Centre of Excellence set up by FSID and C-DOT at IISc Bengaluru is C-DOT's:
articles.question_hi: FSID और C-DOT द्वारा IISc बेंगलुरु में स्थापित नया दूरसंचार उत्कृष्टता केंद्र C-DOT का कौन सा केंद्र है?
articles.explanation: The IISc Bengaluru centre is C-DOT's 5th Centre of Excellence, after IIT Kanpur, IIT Gandhinagar, IIT Roorkee, and IIT Hyderabad.
articles.explanation_hi: IISc बेंगलुरु केंद्र C-DOT का 5वां उत्कृष्टता केंद्र है, जो IIT कानपुर, IIT गांधीनगर, IIT रुड़की और IIT हैदराबाद के बाद है।

articles.title: CCI Approves Merger of Go Digit Infoworks with Go Digit General Insurance
articles.title_hi: CCI ने Go Digit Infoworks का Go Digit General Insurance में विलय स्वीकृत किया
articles.summary: The Competition Commission of India approved the merger of Go Digit Infoworks Services with Go Digit General Insurance, the first such merger under the Sabka Bima Sabki Raksha Act, 2025.
articles.summary_hi: भारतीय प्रतिस्पर्धा आयोग (CCI) ने Go Digit Infoworks Services का Go Digit General Insurance में विलय स्वीकृत किया, जो Sabka Bima Sabki Raksha अधिनियम, 2025 के तहत ऐसा पहला विलय है।
articles.content:
In July 2026, the Competition Commission of India (CCI), under the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, approved the merger of Go Digit Infoworks Services Private Limited (Infoworks) with Go Digit General Insurance Ltd. (GDGIL). The transaction marks the first merger between an insurance company and a non-insurance holding company under the Sabka Bima Sabki Raksha (Amendment of Insurance Laws) Act, 2025.

Under the scheme, Infoworks merges into GDGIL, removing the holding-company layer so shareholders hold shares directly in the insurer. On completion, FAL Corporation, part of Canada's Fairfax group, will hold 57.28% in GDGIL, which is headquartered in Pune, Maharashtra.

For IB ACIO: CCI, Sabka Bima Sabki Raksha Act 2025, Go Digit-GDGIL merger, FAL Corporation (Fairfax) — 57.28% stake.
articles.content_hi:
CCI ने स्वीकृत किया — Go Digit Infoworks का GDGIL में विलय। पहला विलय — Sabka Bima Sabki Raksha Act, 2025 के तहत। FAL Corporation (Fairfax, Canada) — 57.28% हिस्सेदारी। GDGIL मुख्यालय — Pune।

IB ACIO: Sabka Bima Sabki Raksha Act 2025, GDGIL — याद रखें।
articles.question: The merger of Go Digit Infoworks Services with Go Digit General Insurance, approved by CCI in July 2026, is the first such merger under which law?
articles.question_hi: जुलाई 2026 में CCI द्वारा स्वीकृत Go Digit Infoworks Services के Go Digit General Insurance में विलय, किस कानून के तहत ऐसा पहला विलय है?
articles.explanation: This is the first merger between an insurance company and a non-insurance holding company under the Sabka Bima Sabki Raksha (Amendment of Insurance Laws) Act, 2025.
articles.explanation_hi: यह Sabka Bima Sabki Raksha (बीमा कानून संशोधन) अधिनियम, 2025 के तहत बीमा कंपनी और गैर-बीमा होल्डिंग कंपनी के बीच पहला विलय है।

articles.title: CWG 2026: Dilip Gavit Wins Gold in Para Athletics; Neeraj Chopra Begins Javelin Campaign
articles.title_hi: CWG 2026: दिलीप गावित ने पैरा एथलेटिक्स में स्वर्ण जीता; नीरज चोपड़ा ने भाला फेंक अभियान शुरू किया
articles.summary: On Day 7 of the Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games, Dilip Mahadu Gavit won gold with a Games record in the men's 100m T47 para-athletics event, while Neeraj Chopra began his javelin qualifying round.
articles.summary_hi: ग्लासगो 2026 राष्ट्रमंडल खेलों के 7वें दिन, दिलीप महादु गावित ने पुरुषों की 100मी T47 पैरा-एथलेटिक्स स्पर्धा में गेम्स रिकॉर्ड के साथ स्वर्ण जीता, जबकि नीरज चोपड़ा ने अपनी भाला फेंक क्वालीफाइंग राउंड शुरू की।
articles.content:
On Day 7 (30 July) of the 2026 Commonwealth Games in Glasgow, para-athlete Dilip Mahadu Gavit won gold with a Games record of 10.71 seconds in the men's 100m T47, with Mohammed Basil M taking silver in a 1-2 finish for India.

Javelin thrower Neeraj Chopra, the Gold Coast 2018 champion who missed Birmingham 2022 through injury, began his campaign in the men's javelin throw qualifying round, aiming to reclaim his Commonwealth Games title. India's weightlifting campaign also concluded on Day 7, having already added several medals to the tally.

For IB ACIO: Dilip Gavit — gold, Games record, 100m T47; Neeraj Chopra — javelin, seeking 2nd CWG title.
articles.content_hi:
CWG 2026, Day 7 (30 जुलाई): Dilip Mahadu Gavit — स्वर्ण, गेम्स रिकॉर्ड (10.71 सेकंड), पुरुष 100मी T47। Mohammed Basil M — रजत (1-2 फिनिश)। Neeraj Chopra — भाला फेंक क्वालीफाइंग, दूसरा CWG खिताब लक्ष्य।

IB ACIO: Dilip Gavit, 100m T47, Neeraj Chopra — याद रखें।

articles.title: Delhi Cabinet Approves 'Delhi Lakshmi Yojana' for Women
articles.title_hi: दिल्ली मंत्रिमंडल ने महिलाओं हेतु 'दिल्ली लक्ष्मी योजना' स्वीकृत की
articles.summary: The Delhi cabinet, led by CM Rekha Gupta, approved the 'Delhi Lakshmi Yojana' to give eligible women Rs 2,500 monthly assistance, with a Rs 5,110 crore outlay for 2026-27.
articles.summary_hi: मुख्यमंत्री रेखा गुप्ता की अध्यक्षता में दिल्ली मंत्रिमंडल ने पात्र महिलाओं को 2,500 रुपये मासिक सहायता देने हेतु 'दिल्ली लक्ष्मी योजना' स्वीकृत की, जिसका 2026-27 हेतु परिव्यय 5,110 करोड़ रुपये है।
articles.content:
In July 2026, the Delhi cabinet, chaired by Chief Minister Rekha Gupta, approved the 'Delhi Lakshmi Yojana' to provide Rs 2,500 monthly financial assistance to eligible women, with a total budget outlay of Rs 5,110 crore for 2026-27.

Women aged 21-60 years with annual family income up to Rs 2.5 lakh and at least 10 years' residency in Delhi are eligible. Registration opens 1 August 2026, with the first installment on 28 August 2026 (Raksha Bandhan); beneficiaries can opt for Rs 1,500 in an RD/FD account plus Rs 1,000 in a CBDC digital rupee wallet, or the full Rs 2,500 in an RD/FD account.

For IB ACIO: Delhi Lakshmi Yojana, Rs 2,500/month, CM Rekha Gupta, outlay Rs 5,110 crore.
articles.content_hi:
Delhi Lakshmi Yojana: Rs 2,500/माह, CM Rekha Gupta, परिव्यय — Rs 5,110 करोड़ (2026-27)। पात्रता — महिलाएं 21-60 वर्ष, वार्षिक आय ≤ Rs 2.5 लाख। पंजीकरण — 1 अगस्त 2026; पहली किस्त — 28 अगस्त 2026 (रक्षाबंधन)।

IB ACIO: Delhi Lakshmi Yojana, Rekha Gupta — याद रखें।
